How to run

  • make Inferred from manifest settings (in .) — Builds liblua.a and the lua executable using gcc with the makefile's default goal. makefile:113 makefile:124 makefile:83
  • ./lua [script [args]] Inferred from an entrypoint (in .) — Runs the interpreter; with no script it starts the interactive REPL, and LUA_PATH and LUA_CPATH are read at startup to configure module search paths. lua.c:777 loadlib.c:281 loadlib.c:281
  • make liblua.a Inferred from manifest settings (in .) — Builds the static core library from the core, auxiliary, and library object files. makefile:120 makefile:118

Understand a term

Saved explanations from this report, with their sources, questions and places on the map.

Lua (via model)

The programming language whose implementation this repository contains, including its interpreter, core library, and standard libraries.

Files in which this term appears · 73 files
Lua C API (via model)

The set of C functions that a host program calls to create and manipulate Lua states, values, and functions.

Lua C libraries (via model)

C code that extends Lua by registering callable functions, typically built with helper routines and loaded as a shared library.

Lua bytecode (via model)

The binary instruction form of compiled Lua code, which can be written to and read from streams and executed by the runtime.

Lua coroutine (via model)

A Lua execution context that can be paused and resumed, supporting creation, resumption, yielding, and status checks.

Lua functions (via model)

Callable Lua routines, represented by closures, upvalues, and prototypes, and able to be compiled to bytecode.

Files in which this term appears · 4 files
Lua interpreter (via model)

The program that runs Lua code, either from a script file or interactively, and that uses character classification tables.

Files in which this term appears · 1 file
Lua modules (via model)

Loadable units of Lua code or C libraries that are found by searching paths and then opened.

Lua source text (via model)

The original human-readable Lua program text that the compiler parses into functions and bytecode.

Lua state (via model)

The runtime environment holding a Lua thread and its associated data, created and managed over its lifecycle.

Files in which this term appears · 6 files
Lua table (via model)

Lua's associative data structure, supporting storage, lookup, insertion, resizing, iteration, manipulation, and sorting.

Files in which this term appears · 2 files
Lua values (via model)

The distinct kinds of data Lua can hold, along with the conversions performed between them.

Files in which this term appears · 2 files
bytecode (via model)

A compact binary instruction format that Lua source is compiled into and that the runtime executes, rather than reading the original text.

Files in which this term appears · 1 file
closure (via model)

A function together with the variables it captures from the surrounding scope, so those captured variables stay alive and accessible after that scope ends.

Files in which this term appears · 17 files
metamethod (via model)

A function stored in a metatable that Lua calls to define behavior for an operation such as an operator.

Files in which this term appears · 20 files
metatable (via model)

A table attached to a value that Lua consults to find metamethods for operations on that value.

Files in which this term appears · 20 files
module (via model)

A loadable unit of code, such as a Lua file or shared library, that is located, opened, and registered under an entry point.

Files in which this term appears · 11 files
pattern matching (via model)

A facility for matching text against patterns, used as part of Lua's string operations.

Files in which this term appears · 1 file
prototype (via model)

The compiled description of a Lua function, holding the information needed to create closures from it.

Files in which this term appears · 10 files
token (via model)

A small unit of source text, such as an identifier or symbol, produced by the lexer for the parser.

Files in which this term appears · 4 files
upvalue (via model)

A variable captured by a closure from an enclosing scope, kept accessible to that function.

Files in which this term appears · 25 files
userdata (via model)

A Lua value holding arbitrary host data, whose creation, interning, and hashing are managed by the runtime.
